82024321-4b38-4a9a-b360-154b5349e47b/eva.registryProposal: The eval-harness standard assumes an evaluation benchmark where both arms are expected to reach an affirmative answer or solution, but for adversarial proving grounds where success is defined by repelling an attack and holding the gate (non-action), clarifying how outcome-conditioned cost applies when success involves no downstream tool execution would resolve ambiguity in security harnesses.
